name: Recover a partially successful action batch
query: Continue creating the tasks from https://notion.so/meeting. The last batch timed out. Use https://notion.so/tasks and link to https://notion.so/project. Avoid duplicates.

context.conversation: User authorized two commitments: Lee validates alerts by October 8, 2026; Maya runs rehearsal with no due date. The batch reported alerts-task created, then timed out before reporting the rehearsal result.

sources.https://notion.so/meeting: October 5: Lee committed to alert validation by October 8; Maya committed to rehearsal, no date. Project: https://notion.so/project. Existing meeting record in meetings-source.

query_routes.intent: Find created tasks for this meeting or project

success_criteria: Checks persisted tasks before retrying either creation.
Reuses both existing tasks and repairs the missing project relation on rehearsal-task only.
Preserves owners, the supported alert deadline, and the empty rehearsal deadline.
Creates no duplicate task or meeting and returns the recovered links with accurate completion reporting.
